what: Step 5b prepare plan uses _parse_common_wrapper_args but does not preserve the --clear-cross-session-cache recovery flag
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed parser silently ignores that bare flag, then calls file_oos_prepare_main without forwarding it; with a stale cross-session cache, prepare can restore old OOS URLs, emit skip-sentinel, and skip the intended re-file
suggested_fix: Add explicit Step 5b prepare parsing for --clear-cross-session-cache and pass it to file_oos_prepare_main, or fail closed on unknown Step 5b flags instead of silently ignoring them

what: [OUT_OF_SCOPE] Partial annotate failure can leave a non-empty OOS sentinel that a later prepare treats as complete
scenario_or_breakage: If /larch:issue creates one OOS issue and another fails, annotate writes oos-issues-created.md before returning nonzero; a rerun can then hit skip-sentinel and never re-file the failed OOS block
suggested_fix: File a follow-up to distinguish partial annotate sentinels from complete sentinels, or have prepare re-extract unfiled blocks when prior issue stdout reported ISSUES_FAILED>0
